picks.title: 'Musk' Producer, Atwater-Magnific Exec & 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Director Talk AI: "It's Important To Get In The Driver's Seat" — Zurich Summit
picks.excerpt: 'Musk' Producer, Atwater-Magnific Exec & 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Director Talk AI: "It's Important To Get In The Driver's Seat" - Zurich Summit
picks.rationale: Freshest item in the pool: working producers, an AI-tool exec and an AI-feature director at Zurich Summit on how filmmakers should take control of AI in production. This is a new event, not the Tilly Norwood panel.

picks.title: Why a Gaussian 'splat' helps lighting — go 3D+2D, not all-3D
picks.excerpt: A breakdown of how Gaussian splats, video models, and traditional 3D exports can work together for lighting, FX, and production control.
picks.rationale: Actionable VFX craft: a hybrid pipeline that combines Gaussian splats, video models and 3D exports for lighting control. It is a different fxguide video from the Flow Studio one.

picks.title: Video Editing Is About to Change Forever
picks.excerpt: Curious Refuge puts OpenAI Astra through real video editing workflows and reports the results.
picks.rationale: Hands-on test of OpenAI Astra in real editing workflows. It shows editors what the tool can do in practice and adds a different outlet to the mix.

picks.title: Robin Williams' Daughter Calls for Fans Creating AI Videos of the Actor to 'Have Some Shame'
picks.excerpt: Zelda Williams is calling for fans to stop circulating AI-generated videos of her late father, Robin Williams.
picks.rationale: A new public statement on AI likenesses of deceased actors. It is a different event from the 08-19 Instagram-revival card and adds to the running thread on digital-likeness ethics.

picks.title: Jia Zhangke Readies Zhao Tao Road Movie 'Mamma Dunhuang,' Rules Out AI in Production (EXCLUSIVE)
picks.excerpt: Jia Zhangke sets Zhao Tao road movie "Mamma Dunhuang," rules out AI in production and discusses Pingyao's future.
picks.rationale: Fresh exclusive: a major auteur explicitly rules out AI on his next feature, a counterpoint to the pro-AI picks. The AI angle is narrow, so enrichment should confirm the body covers it in substance.
